description: This file acts as a facade or wrapper module that loads a bundled plugin surface module for Amazon Bedrock. It provides re-exported functions such as discoverBedrockModels, mergeImplicitBedrockProvider, resetBedrockDiscoveryCacheForTest, resolveBedrockConfigApiKey, and resolveImplicitBedrockProvider, which internally load a module dynamically and invoke its methods.

methods.name: function loadFacadeModule(): FacadeModule { loadFacadeModule
methods.description: Synchronously loads the ambient FacadeModule for Amazon Bedrock using the loadBundledPluginPublicSurfaceModuleSync function, specifying directory and artifact basename.
